description:
Role Name: Android Developer 
 Duration: 12+ Months 
 
 3+ years of proficiency with Android Application development is mandatory, 5 years preferred 
 2+ years of proficiency with Web Apps (Angular, React, Amber, Vue, etc) is preferred 
 2+ years of experience with QT / QML is preferred 
 Basic Embedded Systems knowledge (Linux, Graphics, Media, RTOS, etc) 
 Ability to quickly prototype and debug code around variety of hardware (RPi, NVidia, etc) 
 Experience with embedded device build systems like Yocto, and development with Git/Stash, etc 
 Good communication and team work skills 
 IOS application development experience is a plus (preferred) 
 Exposure to AR / VR / Machine Learning (preferred) 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
years_evidence: 2+ years of experience with QT / QML is preferred
